headline: Australian Federal Court Orders Apple to Open Devices to Rival App Stores
summary: Australia's Federal Court ruled that Apple breached competition law and ordered it to open devices to third-party app stores, paving the way for Fortnite's return.
why: Apple's App Store commissions generate tens of billions in high-margin services revenue, currently under antitrust pressure globally.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Court-mandated third-party app stores threaten Apple's 30% App Store commission model.

impacts.name: Mobile Gaming & Software
impacts.why: Developers gain direct billing channels and lower distribution take rates in Australia.
